segmentos.texto: Guys I've been hiding something from you for a very long time. This is tato one. This is literally like a dream bottle
I spray this on all my friends and every single person will leave the restaurant that night
I have gotten a compliment on how good they smell
I've never gotten more compliments on a perfume in my entire life
And this is because it has a little thing in it called iso and it enhances your own smell so it smells different on everyone
It's insane. Hope you guys love it as much as I do. I'm pumped. I hope you love it
